source: NASA/JPL Horizons API (ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api), heliocentric ecliptic J2000, au

craft.name: Voyager 1
craft.note: Launched in 1977; the farthest human-made object, in interstellar space since 2012.

craft.name: Voyager 2
craft.note: Launched in 1977; the only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune; in interstellar space since 2018.

craft.name: New Horizons
craft.note: Flew past Pluto in 2015 and the small world Arrokoth in 2019; now in the Kuiper belt.

craft.name: Parker Solar Probe
craft.note: Flies closer to the Sun than any spacecraft before it, through the Sun's outer atmosphere.

craft.name: Lucy
craft.note: On a twelve-year tour of the Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter's orbit.

craft.name: Psyche
craft.note: On its way to the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche, arriving in 2029.

craft.name: OSIRIS-APEX
craft.note: As OSIRIS-REx it brought samples of asteroid Bennu to Earth in 2023; now heading for Apophis, arriving in 2029.

craft.name: Hera
craft.note: ESA's mission to the asteroid pair Didymos and Dimorphos, which NASA's DART probe struck in 2022.

craft.name: James Webb Space Telescope
craft.note: The James Webb Space Telescope, about 1.5 million km from Earth on the side away from the Sun.

craft.name: Europa Clipper
craft.short: on its way to Jupiter's moon Europa
craft.note: On its way to Jupiter's moon Europa, arriving in 2030.

craft.name: Juno
craft.note: Launched in 2011 and orbiting Jupiter since 2016.
